messages:
maya: Morning — EU GPU pool is saturated, queue depth ~800 and 95p latency jumped. Autoscaler attempted scale but was blocked by quota_exceeded.
sam: Any recent deploys or drainer jobs? did we accidentally reduce pool size?
maya: No deploys. Spike seems correlated with hosted-api /chat-small route — lots of short-chat traffic.
leo: Sounds like head-of-line blocking. With global FIFO a noisy route can stall everything.
anika: Current setup: global FIFO runtime queue + token-bucket per-tenant + low per-route rate limits. We discussed per-route admission but never shipped it.
vincent: Short-term mitigation: enable per-route soft-limits and allow preemption for low-priority routes. Canary on a tiny slice first.
sam: Clarify "preemption": evict queued low-priority requests when capacity needed? that could cause bad UX for some apps.
maya: Agreed. Alternative: priority aging — after N seconds in queue, bump request priority so it doesn't starve forever. Keeps fairness without immediate cancels.
ops-bot: ALERT: autoscaler action failed: quota_exceeded: account_gpu_cores. Docs: https://infra.internal/limits
leo: If quotas block scaling, we can reassign burst capacity from batch pools to hosted for now (manual override).
vincent: Cross-region fallback (EU -> US) is possible but adds egress cost and latency; good as last resort to avoid 503s.
sam: Need a clear playbook: when to route cross-region vs fail-fast vs queue-preemption.
anika: Long-term: per-route QoS — reserve min slots for high-SLO routes, shared pool for best-effort. Helps predictable SLOs.
maya: Also need better observability: per-route queue depth, enqueue rate, avg service time, and head-of-line indicators on dashboards.
leo: Proposed alert: per-route queue_depth > 200 for 5m AND enq_rate > 50/s -> run the mitigation playbook (softlimits + aging enable).
anika: I'll open a PR to flip softlimits and add priority aging + metrics. Canary to 10% traffic if possible.
maya: +1. Sam/Leo can you own rollout and rollback criteria? define SLO thresholds and cost delta we accept.
sam: I'll set rollback: 95p latency > 30% or error rate > 1% over baseline -> immediate rollback.
vincent: Also inform CS/sales proactively if we route customers cross-region or preempt traffic.
ops-bot: ACTION: incident placeholder INC-2028-34 created and assigned to eng-infra.
maya: Thanks — pairing session in 15 mins to validate metrics and PR checklist.
